summary:
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — A major refactor introduces FCC-SEED as a vertex-detector option across FCC detector concepts, adding new versions `CLD_o5_v01` and `ALLEGRO` updates (revised pixel pitches, single-layer Silicon Wrapper) while leaving ILD on its current default for now ([#612](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612)). The ALLEGRO HCAL three-parts endcap pseudo-layer position calculation has been fixed for PandoraPFA, affecting downstream calorimeter reconstruction ([#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666)). Additional utility improvements include mapping volumes to the nearest ROOT predefined colour in `dd4hep2root.py` for cleaner geometry visualisation ([#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662)), and a CODEOWNERS refresh to improve review routing ([#651](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/651)).
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker)** — `DCHdigi_v02` has been renamed to `WireTrackerDigi_v01` and generalised to handle both drift chambers and straw-tube trackers via a new `isSTT` Gaudi property (switching `nphi`→`tube` and using `sector` in the cellID). This is a breaking change for existing steering files referencing the old name; the Genfit track fitter's `WireTrackerName` property must also be updated accordingly ([#100](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/100)).
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — Follow-ups to the digitiser rename fix the resulting k4run crashes for ALLEGRO and IDEA `run_digi_reco.py` steering ([#395](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/395)) and wire the new STT digitiser into the ALLEGRO `o2_v01` reconstruction chain, including an update to `GenfitTrackFitter.WireTrackerName` so tracking runs cleanly ([#388](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/388)). Track validation is now exposed as an option in both IDEA and ALLEGRO ctests, adding `--addTruthTracks`/`--runTrkValidation` switches ([#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386)). Delphes/EDM4hep IDEA cards have been restored on `main` and the Pythia8 ZH/ZZ/WW ecm240 generator cards updated to their `winter2023` versions ([#393](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/393)).
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes)** — Photon pointing information is now propagated to EDM4hep: `ITheta`/`IPhi` and `directionError` store pointing angles and errors, and `positionError` stores computed hit-position errors for `errorPhi`/`errorTheta`, enabling downstream photon-pointing analyses ([#161](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/161)). Requires Delphes ≥ 3.5.2pre02.
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — The deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload is now hidden from Cling/cppyy to avoid Python bindings selecting the wrong overload, restoring correct behaviour in interactive/analysis workflows ([#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524)).
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — Adds edge sorting/flipping in the GNN track finder to reorient edges from inner to outer hit, matching the acorn training convention and reproducing that pipeline's behaviour ([#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/103)). Also improves user-friendliness by making `--compactFile` a required argument in CKF, GNN, and geometry-visualisation option scripts, replacing an opaque Gaudi `TypeError` with a clear argparse error ([#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97)).
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — `k4run` now accepts `--evt-max` as an alias for `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax`, aligning the CLI with Gaudi terminology and making the event-limit knob easier to discover ([#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431)).
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — The CSG-based CAD exporter in DDCAD was removed because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private, breaking builds against current ROOT ([#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681)). A follow-up reimplementation using only public ROOT APIs is planned to restore the functionality; users depending on the ASSIMP writer should be aware of the temporary regression.
- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora)** — The PFO comparison test script is updated to work with the current EDM4hep API, unblocking Pandora regression tests in CI ([#54](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/54)).
- **[hep-fcc/FCCeePhysicsStudies](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies)** — Documents FSR lattice beam parameters (still GHC-based, since LCC values above the Z pole are not yet available, but similar at the IP) for reference in physics studies ([#61](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies/pull/61)).
- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — Rendering improvements shrink child volumes that fully overlap their parent, fix a missing field in `concatenateOutput.ts`, tune transparency and `numFaces` defaults, and clean up conversion logic — noticeably improving FCC geometry visualisation quality ([#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15)).
